title: Dusk Reborn
description: A Pack That Turns All Your Essential PVP Items Into a Dark-purple Color Along With Many Useful Added Features.
body:
**Tired of having to download multiple packs to make your game look clean? Well my pack combines the basics + more all into one pack.**

# **Included components**
- low fire
- no crystal particles 
- small totem
- revamped crystal look
- clear inventory 
- small swords
- dusk-purple color items

## **Gameplay**
- boosts frames
- high quality 
- clean look
- contains the essentials for cpvp/pvp

### **Changed Items**
- Ender pearl
- Golden apple
- Obsidian
- Crystal
- Firework
- Elytra
- Glowstone
- Swords (small swords)
- Totem
- Anchor (when filled)
- Enchant bottle
- **Blue Hearts**
